title: Latch the valve bank
story: A valve chatters when temperature hovers near its threshold. Install a controller with memory.
lesson: Hysteresis uses two thresholds. Readings between them preserve the previous state.
objective: Starting closed, open at >=70, close at <=50. Return a list of booleans, one per reading.
hint: Keep an opened variable between iterations; append it after handling both thresholds.
